latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Clip Editor Online — rapid AI-powered video editing and export via a simple chat-driven interface.

- Instantly edit and export video clips by describing your desired edits; AI handles trimming, transitions, and export.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; export as high-quality 1080p MP4.
- No need for complex editing software or experience — ideal for quick content creation.
- Built-in cloud render pipeline delivers results in 30-90 seconds.
- Handles session management, credits, file uploads, state polling, and error messages seamlessly.
- Clear guidance provided for common workflows, error handling, and supported formats.
